picks.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro - Live on Krea
picks.excerpt: Seedream 5.0 Pro, an advanced image generation and editing model with web-search and deep-reasoning capabilities, is now live on Krea. It lets designers generate, edit, blend and batch images while holding visual consistency and art direction across multiple outputs.
picks.rationale: New generation/editing model live today with batch and cross-output consistency — directly changes how designers art-direct AI imagery tomorrow.

picks.title: Meta's new Muse Image model accepts Instagram accounts as a prompt
picks.excerpt: Meta unveiled Muse Image, an AI model that uses advanced reasoning to parse complex prompts, blend multiple photos into high-quality outputs and render legible in-image text — now powering Stories effects and WhatsApp image generation.
picks.rationale: Major new Meta image model — reasoning prompts, multi-photo blending and reliable in-image text — a novel, credible release distinct from the earlier Content Seal detection tool.

picks.title: Designing quality signals when AI makes everything look credible
picks.excerpt: A UX craft piece on how designers can build trust cues — source transparency, validation, confidence communication and reputation — into products now that AI-generated content looks polished and credible whether or not it is trustworthy.
picks.rationale: Actionable UX-craft framework for building trust signals into AI products — a concrete design responsibility as generated content grows more convincing.

picks.title: Lovable weekly update: reference connectors in chat, search settings, AI-generated image labels
picks.excerpt: Lovable's July 8 release adds in-chat reference connectors, searchable settings, workspace insights and automatic AI-generated image labels to its conversational app builder — incremental workflow polish for designers vibe-coding full-stack apps.
picks.rationale: Fresh shipping update to a widely used vibe-coding tool — reference connectors and auto image labels change the day-to-day builder workflow.

picks.title: This ad says it's not AI slop, but that's exactly what worries me
picks.excerpt: A Creative Bloq commentary on a brand campaign that markets itself as human-made, arguing the 'not AI slop' framing signals how anxiety over generative AI is reshaping creative advertising and how designers position their craft.
picks.rationale: Timely read on how the 'human-made vs AI slop' framing is reshaping how designers position and market their craft — distinct from the earlier RAM-crisis piece.
